properties.name: omop_PERSON.person_id
properties.description: the person domain contains records that uniquely identify each patient in the source data who is time at-risk to have clinical observations recorded within the source systems.;a unique identifier for each person.

properties.name: omop_PERSON.gender_concept_id
properties.description: the person domain contains records that uniquely identify each patient in the source data who is time at-risk to have clinical observations recorded within the source systems.;a foreign key that refers to an identifier in the concept table for the unique gender of the person.

properties.name: omop_PERSON.year_of_birth
properties.description: the person domain contains records that uniquely identify each patient in the source data who is time at-risk to have clinical observations recorded within the source systems.;the year of birth of the person. for data sources with date of birth, the year is extracted. for data sources where the year of birth is not available, the approximate year of birth is derived based on any age group categorization available.

properties.name: omop_PERSON.month_of_birth
properties.description: the person domain contains records that uniquely identify each patient in the source data who is time at-risk to have clinical observations recorded within the source systems.;the month of birth of the person. for data sources that provide the precise date of birth, the month is extracted and stored in this field.

properties.name: omop_PERSON.day_of_birth
properties.description: the person domain contains records that uniquely identify each patient in the source data who is time at-risk to have clinical observations recorded within the source systems.;the day of the month of birth of the person. for data sources that provide the precise date of birth, the day is extracted and stored in this field.

properties.name: omop_PERSON.birth_datetime
properties.description: the person domain contains records that uniquely identify each patient in the source data who is time at-risk to have clinical observations recorded within the source systems.;the date and time of birth of the person.

properties.name: omop_PERSON.death_datetime
properties.description: the person domain contains records that uniquely identify each patient in the source data who is time at-risk to have clinical observations recorded within the source systems.;the date and time of death of the person.

properties.name: omop_PERSON.race_concept_id
properties.description: the person domain contains records that uniquely identify each patient in the source data who is time at-risk to have clinical observations recorded within the source systems.;a foreign key that refers to an identifier in the concept table for the unique race of the person, belonging to the 'race' vocabulary.

properties.name: omop_PERSON.ethnicity_concept_id
properties.description: the person domain contains records that uniquely identify each patient in the source data who is time at-risk to have clinical observations recorded within the source systems.;a foreign key that refers to the standard concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies for the ethnicity of the person, belonging to the 'ethnicity' vocabulary.

properties.name: omop_PERSON.location_id
properties.description: the person domain contains records that uniquely identify each patient in the source data who is time at-risk to have clinical observations recorded within the source systems.;a foreign key to the place of residency for the person in the location table, where the detailed address information is stored.

properties.name: omop_PERSON.provider_id
properties.description: the person domain contains records that uniquely identify each patient in the source data who is time at-risk to have clinical observations recorded within the source systems.;a foreign key to the primary care provider the person is seeing in the provider table.

properties.name: omop_PERSON.care_site_id
properties.description: the person domain contains records that uniquely identify each patient in the source data who is time at-risk to have clinical observations recorded within the source systems.;a foreign key to the site of primary care in the care_site table, where the details of the care site are stored.

properties.name: omop_PERSON.person_source_value
properties.description: the person domain contains records that uniquely identify each patient in the source data who is time at-risk to have clinical observations recorded within the source systems.;an (encrypted) key derived from the person identifier in the source data. this is necessary when a use case requires a link back to the person data at the source dataset.

properties.name: omop_PERSON.gender_source_value
properties.description: the person domain contains records that uniquely identify each patient in the source data who is time at-risk to have clinical observations recorded within the source systems.;the source code for the gender of the person as it appears in the source data. the person’s gender is mapped to a standard gender concept in the standardized vocabularies; the original value is stored here for reference.

properties.name: omop_PERSON.gender_source_concept_id
properties.description: the person domain contains records that uniquely identify each patient in the source data who is time at-risk to have clinical observations recorded within the source systems.;a foreign key to the gender concept that refers to the code used in the source.

properties.name: omop_PERSON.race_source_value
properties.description: the person domain contains records that uniquely identify each patient in the source data who is time at-risk to have clinical observations recorded within the source systems.;the source code for the race of the person as it appears in the source data. the person race is mapped to a standard race concept in the standardized vocabularies and the original value is stored here for reference.

properties.name: omop_PERSON.race_source_concept_id
properties.description: the person domain contains records that uniquely identify each patient in the source data who is time at-risk to have clinical observations recorded within the source systems.;a foreign key to the race concept that refers to the code used in the source.

properties.name: omop_PERSON.ethnicity_source_value
properties.description: the person domain contains records that uniquely identify each patient in the source data who is time at-risk to have clinical observations recorded within the source systems.;the source code for the ethnicity of the person as it appears in the source data. the person ethnicity is mapped to a standard ethnicity concept in the standardized vocabularies and the original code is, stored here for reference.

properties.name: omop_PERSON.ethnicity_source_concept_id
properties.description: the person domain contains records that uniquely identify each patient in the source data who is time at-risk to have clinical observations recorded within the source systems.;a foreign key to the ethnicity concept that refers to the code used in the source.

properties.name: mimic_PATIENTS.subject_id
properties.description: patients contains all charted data for all patients.;subject_id is a unique identifier which specifies an individual patient.

properties.name: mimic_PATIENTS.gender
properties.description: patients contains all charted data for all patients.;gender is the genotypical sex of the patient.

properties.name: mimic_PATIENTS.dob
properties.description: patients contains all charted data for all patients.;dob is the date of birth of the given patient.

properties.name: mimic_PATIENTS.dod
properties.description: patients contains all charted data for all patients.;dod is the date of death for the given patient.

properties.name: mimic_PATIENTS.dod_hosp

properties.name: mimic_PATIENTS.dod_ssn
properties.description: patients contains all charted data for all patients.;dod_ssn is the date of death from the social security database.

properties.name: mimic_PATIENTS.expire_flag

reasoning.justification: The user query involves mapping 'omop measurement' with 'mimic labevents'. In OMOP, 'measurement' is a type that includes 'measurement_concept_id' as a property. This property is directly relevant as it links to the specific measurement concept in the OMOP Common Data Model, which can be mapped to lab events in Mimic.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.measurement_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a unique identifier for each measurement.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.person_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key identifier to the person about whom the measurement was recorded. the demographic details of that person are stored in the person table.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.measurement_concept_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key to the standard measurement concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies. these belong to the 'measurement' domain, but could overlap with the 'observation' domain (see #3 below).

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.measurement_date
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;the date of the measurement.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.measurement_datetime
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;the date and time of the measurement. some database systems don't have a datatype of time. to accommodate all temporal analyses, datatype datetime can be used (combining measurement_date and measurement_time forum discussion)

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.measurement_time
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;the time of the measurement. this is present for backwards compatibility and will be deprecated in an upcoming version

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.measurement_type_concept_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key to the predefined concept in the standardized vocabularies reflecting the provenance from where the measurement record was recorded. these belong to the 'meas type' vocabulary

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.operator_concept_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key identifier to the predefined concept in the standardized vocabularies reflecting the mathematical operator that is applied to the value_as_number. operators are <, <=, =, >=, > and these concepts belong to the 'meas value operator' domain.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.value_as_number
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a measurement result where the result is expressed as a numeric value.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.value_as_concept_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key to a measurement result represented as a concept from the standardized vocabularies (e.g., positive/negative, present/absent, low/high, etc.). these belong to the 'meas value' domain

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.unit_concept_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key to a standard concept id of measurement units in the standardized vocabularies that belong to the 'unit' domain.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.range_low
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;the lower limit of the normal range of the measurement result. the lower range is assumed to be of the same unit of measure as the measurement value.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.range_high
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;the upper limit of the normal range of the measurement. the upper range is assumed to be of the same unit of measure as the measurement value.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.provider_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key to the provider in the provider table who was responsible for initiating or obtaining the measurement.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.visit_occurrence_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key to the visit in the visit_occurrence table during which the measurement was recorded.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.visit_detail_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key to the visit detail in the visit_detail table during which the measurement was recorded.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.measurement_source_value
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;the measurement name as it appears in the source data. this code is mapped to a standard concept in the standardized vocabularies and the original code is stored here for reference.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.measurement_source_concept_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key to a concept in the standard vocabularies that refers to the code used in the source.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.unit_source_value
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;the source code for the unit as it appears in the source data. this code is mapped to a standard unit concept in the standardized vocabularies and the original code is stored here for reference.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.value_source_value
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;the source value associated with the content of the value_as_number or value_as_concept_id as stored in the source data.

properties.name: mimic_LABEVENTS.charttime
properties.description: labevents contains all laboratory measurements for a given patient, including out patient data.;charttime records the time at which an observation was made, and is usually the closest proxy to the time the data was actually measured.

properties.name: mimic_LABEVENTS.value
properties.description: labevents contains all laboratory measurements for a given patient, including out patient data.;value contains the value measured for the concept identified by the itemid.

properties.name: mimic_LABEVENTS.valuenum
properties.description: labevents contains all laboratory measurements for a given patient, including out patient data.;valuenum contains the score and valuecontains the score and text describing the meaning of the score.

properties.name: mimic_LABEVENTS.valueuom
properties.description: labevents contains all laboratory measurements for a given patient, including out patient data.;valueuom is the unit of measurement for the value, if appropriate.

properties.name: mimic_LABEVENTS.flag
properties.description: labevents contains all laboratory measurements for a given patient, including out patient data.;flag indicates whether the laboratory value is considered abnormal or not, using pre-defined thresholds.

properties.name: mimic_LABEVENTS.mimic_id
properties.description: labevents contains all laboratory measurements for a given patient, including out patient data.;a unique id for all mimic tables.

reasoning.justification: The user query involves mapping 'omop measurement' with 'mimic chartevents'. In OMOP, 'measurement' is a type that includes properties like 'measurement_value', 'measurement_concept', etc. Since the user query involves measurements, 'measurement_value' is the most relevant property to map with 'mimic chartevents'.

The user query involves mapping 'omop measurement' with 'mimic chartevents'. In OMOP, 'measurement' is a type that includes properties like 'measurement_value', 'measurement_concept', etc. 'measurement_concept' is another relevant property that could be mapped, as it represents the concept associated with the measurement.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.measurement_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a unique identifier for each measurement.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.person_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key identifier to the person about whom the measurement was recorded. the demographic details of that person are stored in the person table.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.measurement_concept_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key to the standard measurement concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies. these belong to the 'measurement' domain, but could overlap with the 'observation' domain (see #3 below).

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.measurement_date
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;the date of the measurement.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.measurement_datetime
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;the date and time of the measurement. some database systems don't have a datatype of time. to accommodate all temporal analyses, datatype datetime can be used (combining measurement_date and measurement_time forum discussion)

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.measurement_time
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;the time of the measurement. this is present for backwards compatibility and will be deprecated in an upcoming version

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.measurement_type_concept_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key to the predefined concept in the standardized vocabularies reflecting the provenance from where the measurement record was recorded. these belong to the 'meas type' vocabulary

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.operator_concept_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key identifier to the predefined concept in the standardized vocabularies reflecting the mathematical operator that is applied to the value_as_number. operators are <, <=, =, >=, > and these concepts belong to the 'meas value operator' domain.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.value_as_number
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a measurement result where the result is expressed as a numeric value.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.value_as_concept_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key to a measurement result represented as a concept from the standardized vocabularies (e.g., positive/negative, present/absent, low/high, etc.). these belong to the 'meas value' domain

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.unit_concept_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key to a standard concept id of measurement units in the standardized vocabularies that belong to the 'unit' domain.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.range_low
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;the lower limit of the normal range of the measurement result. the lower range is assumed to be of the same unit of measure as the measurement value.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.range_high
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;the upper limit of the normal range of the measurement. the upper range is assumed to be of the same unit of measure as the measurement value.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.provider_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key to the provider in the provider table who was responsible for initiating or obtaining the measurement.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.visit_occurrence_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key to the visit in the visit_occurrence table during which the measurement was recorded.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.visit_detail_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key to the visit detail in the visit_detail table during which the measurement was recorded.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.measurement_source_value
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;the measurement name as it appears in the source data. this code is mapped to a standard concept in the standardized vocabularies and the original code is stored here for reference.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.measurement_source_concept_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key to a concept in the standard vocabularies that refers to the code used in the source.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.unit_source_value
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;the source code for the unit as it appears in the source data. this code is mapped to a standard unit concept in the standardized vocabularies and the original code is stored here for reference.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.value_source_value
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;the source value associated with the content of the value_as_number or value_as_concept_id as stored in the source data.

properties.name: mimic_CHARTEVENTS.charttime
properties.description: chartevents contains all the charted data available for a patient. ;charttime records the time at which an observation was made, and is usually the closest proxy to the time the data was actually measured.

properties.name: mimic_CHARTEVENTS.storetime
properties.description: chartevents contains all the charted data available for a patient. ;storetime records the time at which an observation was manually input or manually validated by a member of the clinical staff.

properties.name: mimic_CHARTEVENTS.value
properties.description: chartevents contains all the charted data available for a patient. ;value contains the value measured for the concept identified by the itemid.

properties.name: mimic_CHARTEVENTS.valuenum
properties.description: chartevents contains all the charted data available for a patient. ;valuenum contains the score and value contains the score and text describing the meaning of the score.

properties.name: mimic_CHARTEVENTS.valueuom
properties.description: chartevents contains all the charted data available for a patient. ;valueuom is the unit of measurement for the value, if appropriate.

properties.name: mimic_CHARTEVENTS.warning
properties.description: chartevents contains all the charted data available for a patient. ;warning specifies if a warning for the value was raised and if an error occurred during the measurement.

properties.name: mimic_CHARTEVENTS.error
properties.description: chartevents contains all the charted data available for a patient. ;error specifies if a warning for the value was raised and if an error occurred during the measurement.

properties.name: mimic_CHARTEVENTS.resultstatus
properties.description: chartevents contains all the charted data available for a patient. ;resultstatus specifies the type of measurement.

properties.name: mimic_CHARTEVENTS.stopped
properties.description: chartevents contains all the charted data available for a patient. ;stopped specifies whether the measurement was stopped.

properties.name: mimic_CHARTEVENTS.mimic_id
properties.description: chartevents contains all the charted data available for a patient. ;a unique id for all mimic tables.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.measurement_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a unique identifier for each measurement.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.person_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key identifier to the person about whom the measurement was recorded. the demographic details of that person are stored in the person table.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.measurement_concept_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key to the standard measurement concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies. these belong to the 'measurement' domain, but could overlap with the 'observation' domain (see #3 below).

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.measurement_date
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;the date of the measurement.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.measurement_datetime
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;the date and time of the measurement. some database systems don't have a datatype of time. to accommodate all temporal analyses, datatype datetime can be used (combining measurement_date and measurement_time forum discussion)

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.measurement_time
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;the time of the measurement. this is present for backwards compatibility and will be deprecated in an upcoming version

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.measurement_type_concept_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key to the predefined concept in the standardized vocabularies reflecting the provenance from where the measurement record was recorded. these belong to the 'meas type' vocabulary

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.operator_concept_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key identifier to the predefined concept in the standardized vocabularies reflecting the mathematical operator that is applied to the value_as_number. operators are <, <=, =, >=, > and these concepts belong to the 'meas value operator' domain.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.value_as_number
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a measurement result where the result is expressed as a numeric value.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.value_as_concept_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key to a measurement result represented as a concept from the standardized vocabularies (e.g., positive/negative, present/absent, low/high, etc.). these belong to the 'meas value' domain

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.unit_concept_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key to a standard concept id of measurement units in the standardized vocabularies that belong to the 'unit' domain.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.range_low
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;the lower limit of the normal range of the measurement result. the lower range is assumed to be of the same unit of measure as the measurement value.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.range_high
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;the upper limit of the normal range of the measurement. the upper range is assumed to be of the same unit of measure as the measurement value.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.provider_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key to the provider in the provider table who was responsible for initiating or obtaining the measurement.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.visit_occurrence_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key to the visit in the visit_occurrence table during which the measurement was recorded.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.visit_detail_id
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;a foreign key to the visit detail in the visit_detail table during which the measurement was recorded.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.measurement_source_value
properties.description: the measurement table contains records of measurement, i.e. structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a person or person's sample. the measurement table contains both orders and results of such measurements as laboratory tests, vital signs, quantitative findings from pathology reports, etc.;the measurement name as it appears in the source data. this code is mapped to a standard concept in the standardized vocabularies and the original code is stored here for reference.

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.measurement_source_concept_id

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.unit_source_value

properties.name: omop_MEASUREMENT.value_source_value

properties.name: omop_PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE.procedure_occurrence_id
properties.description: the procedure_occurrence table contains records of activities or processes ordered by, or carried out by, a healthcare provider on the patient to have a diagnostic or therapeutic purpose. procedures are present in various data sources in different forms with varying levels of standardization.;a system-generated unique identifier for each procedure occurrence.

properties.name: omop_PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE.person_id
properties.description: the procedure_occurrence table contains records of activities or processes ordered by, or carried out by, a healthcare provider on the patient to have a diagnostic or therapeutic purpose. procedures are present in various data sources in different forms with varying levels of standardization.;a foreign key identifier to the person who is subjected to the procedure. the demographic details of that person are stored in the person table.

properties.name: omop_PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE.procedure_concept_id
properties.description: the procedure_occurrence table contains records of activities or processes ordered by, or carried out by, a healthcare provider on the patient to have a diagnostic or therapeutic purpose. procedures are present in various data sources in different forms with varying levels of standardization.;a foreign key that refers to a standard procedure concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies.

properties.name: omop_PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE.procedure_date
properties.description: the procedure_occurrence table contains records of activities or processes ordered by, or carried out by, a healthcare provider on the patient to have a diagnostic or therapeutic purpose. procedures are present in various data sources in different forms with varying levels of standardization.;the date on which the procedure was performed.

properties.name: omop_PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE.procedure_datetime
properties.description: the procedure_occurrence table contains records of activities or processes ordered by, or carried out by, a healthcare provider on the patient to have a diagnostic or therapeutic purpose. procedures are present in various data sources in different forms with varying levels of standardization.;the date and time on which the procedure was performed.

properties.name: omop_PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE.procedure_type_concept_id
properties.description: the procedure_occurrence table contains records of activities or processes ordered by, or carried out by, a healthcare provider on the patient to have a diagnostic or therapeutic purpose. procedures are present in various data sources in different forms with varying levels of standardization.;a foreign key to the predefined concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies reflecting the type of source data from which the procedure record is derived, belonging to the 'procedure type' vocabulary.

properties.name: omop_PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE.modifier_concept_id
properties.description: the procedure_occurrence table contains records of activities or processes ordered by, or carried out by, a healthcare provider on the patient to have a diagnostic or therapeutic purpose. procedures are present in various data sources in different forms with varying levels of standardization.;a foreign key to a standard concept identifier for a modifier to the procedure (e.g. bilateral). these concepts are typically distinguished by 'modifier' concept classes (e.g., 'cpt4 modifier' as part of the 'cpt4' vocabulary).

properties.name: omop_PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE.quantity
properties.description: the procedure_occurrence table contains records of activities or processes ordered by, or carried out by, a healthcare provider on the patient to have a diagnostic or therapeutic purpose. procedures are present in various data sources in different forms with varying levels of standardization.;the quantity of procedures ordered or administered.

properties.name: omop_PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE.provider_id
properties.description: the procedure_occurrence table contains records of activities or processes ordered by, or carried out by, a healthcare provider on the patient to have a diagnostic or therapeutic purpose. procedures are present in various data sources in different forms with varying levels of standardization.;a foreign key to the provider in the provider table who was responsible for carrying out the procedure.

properties.name: omop_PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE.visit_occurrence_id
properties.description: the procedure_occurrence table contains records of activities or processes ordered by, or carried out by, a healthcare provider on the patient to have a diagnostic or therapeutic purpose. procedures are present in various data sources in different forms with varying levels of standardization.;a foreign key to the visit in the visit_occurrence table during which the procedure was carried out.

properties.name: omop_PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE.visit_detail_id
properties.description: the procedure_occurrence table contains records of activities or processes ordered by, or carried out by, a healthcare provider on the patient to have a diagnostic or therapeutic purpose. procedures are present in various data sources in different forms with varying levels of standardization.;a foreign key to the visit detail in the visit_detail table during which the procedure was carried out.

properties.name: omop_PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE.procedure_source_value
properties.description: the procedure_occurrence table contains records of activities or processes ordered by, or carried out by, a healthcare provider on the patient to have a diagnostic or therapeutic purpose. procedures are present in various data sources in different forms with varying levels of standardization.;the source code for the procedure as it appears in the source data. this code is mapped to a standard procedure concept in the standardized vocabularies and the original code is, stored here for reference. procedure source codes are typically icd-9-proc, cpt-4, hcpcs or opcs-4 codes.

properties.name: omop_PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE.procedure_source_concept_id

properties.name: omop_OBSERVATION.observation_id

properties.name: omop_OBSERVATION.person_id

properties.name: omop_OBSERVATION.observation_concept_id
properties.description: the observation table captures clinical facts about a person obtained in the context of examination, questioning or a procedure. any data that cannot be represented by any other domains, such as social and lifestyle facts, medical history, family history, etc. are recorded here.;a foreign key to the standard observation concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies.

properties.name: omop_OBSERVATION.observation_date
properties.description: the observation table captures clinical facts about a person obtained in the context of examination, questioning or a procedure. any data that cannot be represented by any other domains, such as social and lifestyle facts, medical history, family history, etc. are recorded here.;the date of the observation.

properties.name: omop_OBSERVATION.observation_datetime

properties.name: omop_OBSERVATION.observation_type_concept_id
properties.description: the observation table captures clinical facts about a person obtained in the context of examination, questioning or a procedure. any data that cannot be represented by any other domains, such as social and lifestyle facts, medical history, family history, etc. are recorded here.;a foreign key to the predefined concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies reflecting the type of the observation.

properties.name: omop_OBSERVATION.value_as_number

properties.name: omop_OBSERVATION.value_as_string

properties.name: omop_OBSERVATION.value_as_concept_id

properties.name: omop_OBSERVATION.provider_id

properties.name: mimic_CHARTEVENTS.storetime

reasoning.justification: The user query involves mapping OMOP drug exposure, which directly corresponds to the DRUG_EXPOSURE type in the OMOP product. The property 'drug_exposure_event_id' is relevant as it uniquely identifies each drug exposure event in the OMOP Common Data Model.

The user query also mentions Mimic inputevents, which can be mapped to the 'drug_concept_id' property in OMOP's DRUG_EXPOSURE type. This property links the drug exposure event to a specific drug concept in the OMOP Common Data Model, allowing for standardized drug representation.

properties.name: omop_DRUG_EXPOSURE.drug_exposure_id
properties.description: the 'drug' domain captures records about the utilization of a drug when ingested or otherwise introduced into the body. a drug is a biochemical substance formulated in such a way that when administered to a person it will exert a certain physiological effect. drugs include prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vaccines, and large-molecule biologic therapies. radiological devices ingested or applied locally do not count as drugs.;a system-generated unique identifier for each drug utilization event.

properties.name: omop_DRUG_EXPOSURE.person_id
properties.description: the 'drug' domain captures records about the utilization of a drug when ingested or otherwise introduced into the body. a drug is a biochemical substance formulated in such a way that when administered to a person it will exert a certain physiological effect. drugs include prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vaccines, and large-molecule biologic therapies. radiological devices ingested or applied locally do not count as drugs.;a foreign key identifier to the person who is subjected to the drug. the demographic details of that person are stored in the person table.

properties.name: omop_DRUG_EXPOSURE.drug_concept_id
properties.description: the 'drug' domain captures records about the utilization of a drug when ingested or otherwise introduced into the body. a drug is a biochemical substance formulated in such a way that when administered to a person it will exert a certain physiological effect. drugs include prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vaccines, and large-molecule biologic therapies. radiological devices ingested or applied locally do not count as drugs.;a foreign key that refers to a standard concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies belonging to the 'drug' domain.

properties.name: omop_DRUG_EXPOSURE.drug_exposure_start_date
properties.description: the 'drug' domain captures records about the utilization of a drug when ingested or otherwise introduced into the body. a drug is a biochemical substance formulated in such a way that when administered to a person it will exert a certain physiological effect. drugs include prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vaccines, and large-molecule biologic therapies. radiological devices ingested or applied locally do not count as drugs.;the start date for the current instance of drug utilization. valid entries include a start date of a prescription, the date a prescription was filled, or the date on which a drug administration procedure was recorded.

properties.name: omop_DRUG_EXPOSURE.drug_exposure_start_datetime
properties.description: the 'drug' domain captures records about the utilization of a drug when ingested or otherwise introduced into the body. a drug is a biochemical substance formulated in such a way that when administered to a person it will exert a certain physiological effect. drugs include prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vaccines, and large-molecule biologic therapies. radiological devices ingested or applied locally do not count as drugs.;the start date and time for the current instance of drug utilization. valid entries include a start datetime of a prescription, the date and time a prescription was filled, or the date and time on which a drug administration procedure was recorded.

properties.name: omop_DRUG_EXPOSURE.drug_exposure_end_date
properties.description: the 'drug' domain captures records about the utilization of a drug when ingested or otherwise introduced into the body. a drug is a biochemical substance formulated in such a way that when administered to a person it will exert a certain physiological effect. drugs include prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vaccines, and large-molecule biologic therapies. radiological devices ingested or applied locally do not count as drugs.;the end date for the current instance of drug utilization. depending on different sources, it could be a known or an inferred date and denotes the last day at which the patient was still exposed to drug.

properties.name: omop_DRUG_EXPOSURE.drug_exposure_end_datetime

properties.name: omop_DRUG_EXPOSURE.verbatim_end_date

properties.name: omop_DRUG_EXPOSURE.drug_type_concept_id

properties.name: omop_DRUG_EXPOSURE.stop_reason

properties.name: omop_DRUG_EXPOSURE.drug_exposure_id
properties.description: the 'drug' domain captures records about the utilization of a drug when ingested or otherwise introduced into the body. a drug is a biochemical substance formulated in such a way that when administered to a person it will exert a certain physiological effect. drugs include prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vaccines, and large-molecule biologic therapies. radiological devices ingested or applied locally do not count as drugs.;a system-generated unique identifier for each drug utilization event.

properties.name: omop_DRUG_EXPOSURE.person_id
properties.description: the 'drug' domain captures records about the utilization of a drug when ingested or otherwise introduced into the body. a drug is a biochemical substance formulated in such a way that when administered to a person it will exert a certain physiological effect. drugs include prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vaccines, and large-molecule biologic therapies. radiological devices ingested or applied locally do not count as drugs.;a foreign key identifier to the person who is subjected to the drug. the demographic details of that person are stored in the person table.

properties.name: omop_DRUG_EXPOSURE.drug_concept_id
properties.description: the 'drug' domain captures records about the utilization of a drug when ingested or otherwise introduced into the body. a drug is a biochemical substance formulated in such a way that when administered to a person it will exert a certain physiological effect. drugs include prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vaccines, and large-molecule biologic therapies. radiological devices ingested or applied locally do not count as drugs.;a foreign key that refers to a standard concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies belonging to the 'drug' domain.

properties.name: omop_DRUG_EXPOSURE.drug_exposure_start_date
properties.description: the 'drug' domain captures records about the utilization of a drug when ingested or otherwise introduced into the body. a drug is a biochemical substance formulated in such a way that when administered to a person it will exert a certain physiological effect. drugs include prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vaccines, and large-molecule biologic therapies. radiological devices ingested or applied locally do not count as drugs.;the start date for the current instance of drug utilization. valid entries include a start date of a prescription, the date a prescription was filled, or the date on which a drug administration procedure was recorded.

properties.name: omop_DRUG_EXPOSURE.drug_exposure_start_datetime
properties.description: the 'drug' domain captures records about the utilization of a drug when ingested or otherwise introduced into the body. a drug is a biochemical substance formulated in such a way that when administered to a person it will exert a certain physiological effect. drugs include prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vaccines, and large-molecule biologic therapies. radiological devices ingested or applied locally do not count as drugs.;the start date and time for the current instance of drug utilization. valid entries include a start datetime of a prescription, the date and time a prescription was filled, or the date and time on which a drug administration procedure was recorded.

properties.name: omop_DRUG_EXPOSURE.drug_exposure_end_date

properties.name: omop_DRUG_EXPOSURE.drug_exposure_end_datetime

properties.name: omop_DRUG_EXPOSURE.drug_exposure_id
properties.description: the 'drug' domain captures records about the utilization of a drug when ingested or otherwise introduced into the body. a drug is a biochemical substance formulated in such a way that when administered to a person it will exert a certain physiological effect. drugs include prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vaccines, and large-molecule biologic therapies. radiological devices ingested or applied locally do not count as drugs.;a system-generated unique identifier for each drug utilization event.

properties.name: omop_DRUG_EXPOSURE.person_id
properties.description: the 'drug' domain captures records about the utilization of a drug when ingested or otherwise introduced into the body. a drug is a biochemical substance formulated in such a way that when administered to a person it will exert a certain physiological effect. drugs include prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vaccines, and large-molecule biologic therapies. radiological devices ingested or applied locally do not count as drugs.;a foreign key identifier to the person who is subjected to the drug. the demographic details of that person are stored in the person table.
